intelligence.essence: We Save You Time is Naya's way of looking after your time — your calendar, your booking, and your meetings, all in one place, all connected. Your appointments, your events, your reminders, all organized — so your day runs itself while you do the work only you can do.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine having a helper who remembers everything for you — when soccer practice is, when your friend's birthday is, when it's time to leave — and tells you exactly what to do next. That's Naya with your time: she remembers, so you don't have to.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine a diary that keeps itself — every appointment written in, every birthday remembered, every visit planned — and a kind helper who reminds you gently and gets everything ready before you even ask. That's your calendar with Naya looking after it.
